Code to produce a heatmap using the ggplot2 function

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

```


```{r}
getwd()
setwd("./phd/ppi/psicquicStringHippie-API")
getwd()
```

```{r}
df_final <- read.csv("interactors_of_VCAM1_HUMAN.csv")

# removing the first column
df_interactors <- subset(df_final, select = -X)

# get only the string escore
df_onlyString <- select(df_interactors, c("interactor_of_VCAM1_HUMAN", "string_escore"))

# replace NA values with 0
df_heatmap <- df_onlyString %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)

# make a long df
df_heatmap_long <- df_heatmap %>% pivot_longer(cols="string_escore",
                                                names_to = "score")

```

```{r}
# testing out the simple heatmap
data(mtcars)
cars_dataset <- as.matrix(mtcars)
heatmap(cars_dataset)
View(mtcars)
```


```{r}
df_good <- column_to_rownames(df_interactors, "interactor_of_VCAM1_HUMAN" )
df_heatmap <- df_good %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
df_heatmap_2 <- as.matrix(df_heatmap)
View(df_heatmap_2)
heatmap(df_heatmap_2)
```

```{r}
# create a tibble with one column for depth and one for the value

ggplot(df_heatmap, aes(interactor_of_VCAM1_HUMAN, string_escore, fill = string_score)) + 
  geom_tile()
 # add label inside the tiles:   
  geom_label(aes(label=string_escore),fill="white")+ 
 #  flip y axis:
#   scale_y_reverse(breaks = interactor_of_VCAM1_HUMAN)+
 # remove x axis lable 
  theme( axis.text.x=element_blank())



```

```{r}
# Dummy data
x <- LETTERS[1:20]
y <- paste0("var", seq(1,20))
data <- expand.grid(X=x, Y=y)
data$Z <- runif(400, 0, 5)
 
# Heatmap 
ggplot(data, aes(X, Y, fill= Z)) + 
  geom_tile()

```


```{r}

ggplot(df_heatmap_long, aes(interactor_of_VCAM1_HUMAN, score, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile()


```
